# ATP Flight School

> > ATP Flight School provides accelerated airline pilot training programs with FAA certification, airline partnerships, and career placement support.

ATP Flight School is a leading flight training institution offering comprehensive pilot certification programs including the flagship Airline Career Pilot Program, ATP CTP advanced certification, and introductory flight experiences. The school partners with major airlines like American, Delta, and United to provide cadet programs, financing options including GI Bill benefits, and nationwide training centers with student housing support.

## Key Topics

- Airline Career Pilot Program
- ATP Advantage Guarantee
- ATP CTP (Airline Transport Pilot Certification)
- FAA Pilot Certification
- Commercial Pilot Training
- Airline Cadet Programs
- Flight Training Timeline
- CFI (Certificated Flight Instructor)
- Airline Partnerships (American, Delta, United)
- Financing Options & GI Bill
- 1,500 Flight Hours Requirement
- Admission Prerequisites
- Pilot Career Roadmap
- Airline Pilot Salary
- Flight Training Centers

## Core Programs

- [Airline Career Pilot Program](https://atpflightschool.com/airline-career-pilot-program): Main product page for ATP's flagship nine-month pilot certification program

- [ATP Flight School Homepage](https://atpflightschool.com): ATP Flight School homepage showcasing airline pilot training programs
- [Airline Transport Pilot Certification Training Program (ATP CTP)](https://atpflightschool.com/atp/ctp/index.html): ATP CTP advanced certification program for Airline Transport Pilot eligibility
- [Introductory Flight Experience](https://atpflightschool.com/programs/admissions-flight.html): No-obligation introductory flight experience for prospective ATP students
